name: MG996R metal-gear servo
description: Standard-size metal-gear servo, about 9-11 kg.cm, high stall current (2.5 A).
notes: Wire colours: brown (or black) = GND, red = V+, orange (or yellow / white) = signal. 3-pin 2.54 mm female plug.
Supply 4.8-7.2 V. Budget the stall (peak) current for every servo that can stall at the same time.
Power servos from a separate supply (not the microcontroller 5V/3V3 pin) and join the grounds.
Running current about 0.5-0.9 A at 6 V, stall 2.5 A at 6 V (TowerPro). Four servos stalled together need 10 A.
Size: body 40.7 x 19.7 x 42.9 mm, 54.5 mm across the mounting tabs.

pins.name: SIG
pins.label: signal (orange)
pins.note: 50 Hz pulses, about 0.5-2.5 ms. 3.3 V and 5 V logic both work on most servos.
